symptom: On comores after the 2.18 upgrade a file finalizes immediately and never reaches the review desk — the token appears locked and the task list for agents stays empty.
An applicant whose file was sent back cannot correct it — the file is stuck as filepending with no edit button, and the ereg_process record shows the old status.
After deploying the new Keycloak realm the DS backend returns 500 on every request — the JWT token is missing the aud=account claim and the Python tier rejects it.
Citizens see 'service not found' when opening their application — the error message says the service is no longer available but the backend is running.
The validation bot task succeeds in Camunda but writes nothing to GDB — the multipleBot loop completes in under a second with no record created and the input payload is empty.
After the 2.18 upgrade the commercial register grid shows 0 rows — Graylog reports a DataWeave transformation failed on the field with an accented name used in the date mapping.
After publishing a service the camunda_process_id in activeservices is empty — citizens cannot start a new registration and the DS shows no active service.
A dataSrcCatalog select field sends an empty {} to GDB when the user picks a catalog entry — the catalog column dropped and the GDB record has no data.
New users cannot register — the system requires email verification but the SMTP server returns 554 and the verify email is never sent, so registration fails silently.

After the CAS to Keycloak migration some users are missing their professional category attribute — the profile attribute was not migrated and the protocol-mapper configuration uses the wrong mapper type.

The DS frontend shows a white page for some users but works for me in Chrome — opening in incognito always reproduces the blank page, and it appears to be a 3rd party cookie issue with the Keycloak session check.
The BPA cannot publish a service — formio returns a 401 admin login error saying 'user or password was incorrect', the DS submit 500 shows the backend cannot authenticate, and the publish fails.
A workflow is deadlocked at an inclusive join — multiple execution tokens are parked in act_ru_execution with no tasks and no incidents visible, and the process is completely stuck.
The print preview PDF has all textfield values hidden — numbers show correctly but the text fields appear blank, and the form-preview-pdf template parses the data key incorrectly.

When duplicating a service the BPA fails with a 413 maximum upload size exceeded error — the service duplication exports the service to re-upload it to validate_catalogs but the exported file is too large.
